1432-4613-6858.easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ioreth of the Healing House is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1432-4613-6858.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1432-4613-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Ioreth of the Healing House's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

751-3286-6791.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

401-640-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-640-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-5687--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-5687--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4460-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4399-4518-4716-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-4716-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1987-2556-3110.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2556-3110.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2556-3110.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1409-3099-4289-6791.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

147-3967-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-3967-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-2511-5987.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

877-4089-6967.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Glasspool Mimic
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4785-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

5256-6517-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

284-2292-6972--112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Angel of Invention.
When Angel of Invention dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Angel of Invention enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
284-2292-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Angel of Invention's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1912-3918-4131.description:
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat

527-542-647.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-647.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-3480-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

2060-4499-4929-6073-6457.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Felothar.
When Felothar enters the battlefield, it and Angelic Sell-Sword trigger.
Resolve the Angelic Sell-Sword trigger, creating a token.
Resolve the Felothar trigger, causing you to sacrifice a nonland permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2060-4499-4929-6073-6457.notes: The combo does not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Felothar, Crystalline Crawler or Cryptic Trilobite.

1737-4242-4853-5686.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

1287-5921-6318.easyPrerequisites: You have either {4}{U}{U} or eight {E} available.
1287-5921-6318.description:
Cast Aethertide Whale by paying eight {E} if able or {4}{U}{U} otherwise.
When Aethertide Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Activate Aethertide Whale by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

360-440-1339-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
360-440-1339-2034.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

101-359-372.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-359-372.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1621-5640-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1621-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Wispweaver Angel.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2921-4549-5006.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

2178-4395-5136.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4395-5136.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1594-3260-3540-4740.notablePrerequisites:
"Enchantment" chosen with Cloud Key.
Your life total is at least nine if your storm count is equal to zero, at least six if your storm count is equal to one, at least four if your storm count is equal to two, or at least three otherwise.
1594-3260-3540-4740.description:
Cast Mourning by paying 2 life, targeting K'rrik.
Aetherflux Reservoir and K'rrik trigger.
Resolve the K'rrik trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain an amount of life equal to your storm count.
Resolve Mourning, attaching it to K'rrik.
Activate Mourning by paying 2 life, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may use Aetherflux Reservoir's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

262-859-1545.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-1545.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Trostani four times.
Resolve the first Trostani trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

3259-3920.easyPrerequisites: Valduk has at least one Aura and/or Equipment attached to it.
3259-3920.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3920.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Valduk triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

231-596-1361-4067.description:
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Darksteel Citadel, untapping Ancient Den.
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Ancient Den from the battlefield to your hand, returning Darksteel Citadel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Ancient Den, untapping any applicable permanent.
Activate Tameshi by paying {W} and returning Darksteel Citadel from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ancient Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2316-3129-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-3129-5231.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.
